name: Compressed 48-reign fixture using JAC_Test_EraTiming: official future to Shoho at 19 and Keian at 21, ledger and suppressed official UI

steps.code:
GameConfiguration.SetValue('JAC_ERA_TIMING_TAIL', true)
if GameConfiguration.GetValue('JAC_ERA_TIMING_TAIL')~=true then error('tail fixture flag not set') end
return true

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' or GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()~=1 then error('wrong ruleset/start turn') end
if GameInfo.GameSpeeds[GameConfiguration.GetGameSpeedType()].GameSpeedType~='GAMESPEED_STANDARD' then error('wrong speed') end
local fixture=GameInfo.GlobalParameters['JAC_TEST_ERA_TAIL_VERSION']
if not fixture or tonumber(fixture.Value)~=1 then error('optional tail fixture not loaded') end
if tonumber(GameInfo.GlobalParameters['NEXT_ERA_TURN_COUNTDOWN'].Value)~=1 then error('wrong countdown') end
local rows={}; for row in GameInfo.Eras_XP1() do rows[row.EraType]=row end
local count=0
for era in GameInfo.Eras() do
 count=count+1
 local row=rows[era.EraType]
 if not row then error('missing era length '..era.EraType) end
 if era.EraType=='ERA_JAC_CHIDAI' then
  if row.GameEraMinimumTurns~=nil or row.GameEraMaximumTurns~=nil then error('terminal era must be endless') end
 elseif row.GameEraMinimumTurns~=2 or row.GameEraMaximumTurns~=2 then error('compressed length missing '..era.EraType) end
end
if count~=48 then error('expected 48 eras') end
return true

local T,n,kind=18,8,'ERA_FUTURE'
local t=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1
if t~=T then error('turn '..t..' expected '..T) end
local index=GameInfo.Eras[kind].Index
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()~=index then error('era mismatch on turn '..T..': '..tostring(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra())) end
local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
if type(l)~='table' or l.reign~=n or type(l.history)~='table' then error('ledger reign mismatch on turn '..T) end
if l.history['r'..(n+1)]~=nil then error('next reign judged early') end
return true

if l.history['r'..(n+1)]~=nil then error('next reign judged early') end
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEraStartTurn()~=17 then error('engine era start mismatch') end
return true

if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('official era popup shown') end
StartEraShow()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('official era popup opened') end
return 'official era popup suppressed'

local T,n,kind=19,9,'ERA_JAC_SHOHO'
local t=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1
if t~=T then error('turn '..t..' expected '..T) end
local index=GameInfo.Eras[kind].Index
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()~=index then error('era mismatch on turn '..T..': '..tostring(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra())) end
local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
if type(l)~='table' or l.reign~=n or type(l.history)~='table' then error('ledger reign mismatch on turn '..T) end
if l.history['r'..(n+1)]~=nil then error('next reign judged early') end

local h=l.history['r'..n]
if type(h)~='table' or h.turn~=T or h.due~=T or h.length~=2 or h.from~=n-1 then error('judgement mismatch on turn '..T) end
if type(h.p0)~='table' then error('human judgement missing') end
print('[JAC_ERA_VERIFY] turn='..T..' reign='..n..' era='..kind..' ledgerEngineEra='..tostring(h.engineEra))
return true

local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
local r=l and l.history and l.history['r9'] and l.history['r9'].p0
if type(r)~='table' then error('human ledger result missing') end
local last=JAC_REIGN_POPUP_LAST
if type(last)~='table' or last.reign~=9 or last.reignType~='REIGN_SHOHO' or last.turn~=19 or last.age~=r.age or last.score~=r.score then error('automatic reign popup record mismatch') end
if ContextPtr:IsHidden() and not JAC_ShowReignPopup(true) then error('cannot reopen reign popup') end
if ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('reign popup hidden') end
if Controls.Title:GetText()~=Locale.ToUpper(Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_REIGN_SHOHO_ANNOUNCEMENT')) then error('reign title mismatch') end
if Controls.EraRibbonValue:GetText()~=JAC_AgesView_AgeLabel(r.age) then error('age label mismatch') end
if Controls.Score:GetText()~=Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_AGE_REIGN_SCORE','LOC_JAC_REIGN_KAN_EI_NAME',r.score) then error('score text mismatch') end
OnClose()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('reign popup did not close') end
return true
